items.title: Stocks to Watch Recap: Lennar, Generac, Volvo
items.summary: ↗️ Generac Holdings (GNRC): Shares closed up 18.3% after the backup-power company signed a $2.4 billion deal to sell data-center generators to Amazon. 🔎 Lennar (LEN): The homebuilder cut its home delivery target for the full year, citing interest-rate pressure and worsening conditions in the housing market, as its revenue and profit fell in the third quarter.
